spec_match.rationale: The wavetable lives in the global scope (synth-module.js). Updates go once via audioWorklet.port, or per node in the labelled fallback. Voices report the table version they render.

interactive.rationale: Play/stop, wavetable select, SVG waveform, message counter and per-voice status.

edge_cases.rationale: Prevents double start and closes the context on stop. A voice created between per-node sends is described but not demonstrated.

conformance.rationale: Backs global-scope-round-trip in spirit, plus audioworklet-port-attribute.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless with --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required, default and with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features (and separately --enable-blink-features=AudioWorkletSharedPort): 'port' in AudioWorklet.prototype is false in all of them, so only the labelled fallback branches ran. Both viewports, every control exercised, console/network clean, 0px overflow. Fallback observed: all three voices reported table v3 and the counter showed 3 messages per change.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts each voice picking up the current version, with shared/fallback in details.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select, a voice list with an aria-label, a status line and a Stop control.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Voices collapse to one column. 0px overflow.

openQuestions.title: Verify the shared-port branches on Chrome 160+ or Firefox 138+
openQuestions.detail: The shared-port code (scope port.onmessage, audioWorklet.port.postMessage with transfer) is written to the spec IDL but could not run in Chrome 153. Run every concept on a supporting build and confirm the ping/pong, the reader seeing 'AudioWorkletGlobalScope.port', a single message per table change, and the pipe via audioWorklet.port.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Controls should be at least 44x44 CSS px on touch screens, and components should adapt to their container so nothing overflows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons, selects, inputs and ranges have min-height 44px. Selects inside .field are width:100% after a measured 117px overflow at 360px caused by long option text. Every page was re-measured at 0px overflow at 360x740 and 1280x800.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: drive.js runs: overflow=0 on every page/viewport; responsive-check desktop ok 1/1, mobile ok 1/1

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native controls with labels. Announce discrete outcomes through polite status/log regions and keep rapidly changing values out of live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every control is a native button/select/input with a visible label. Outcomes go to role=status / role=log regions. High-frequency readouts (slider positions, meters) use aria-live=off and announce only on change of state.

guidanceConsulted.query: pause canvas animation or audio processing off-screen
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pause heavy rendering work when content is skipped (content-visibility / contentvisibilityautostatechange).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception: nothing runs continuously without the user asking. Audio or animation starts only from an explicit button and has its own Stop button, so off-screen pausing would interrupt audio the user started on purpose.

summary: A practical multi-voice synth that shows the one-message vs N-messages cost of scope-wide state.
